title: Negation: 不 vs 没(有), 不要
description: Which negative goes where: 不 for habits, plans and adjectives; 没(有) for the past and for 有; 不要 for 'don't!'.

points.title: 不 + verb / adjective
points.summary: 不 (bù) negates the present, habits, future plans, wishes and adjectives. Before a 4th tone it becomes bú.
points.body:
- Habits / general facts: 我**不**喝咖啡 (I don't drink coffee).
- Plans: 明天我**不**去 (I'm not going tomorrow).
- Adjectives: 不贵, 不冷.
- 是 and 在 are negated with 不: 不是, 不在.
- **Never** 不有 — 有 only takes 没.
examples: This piece of clothing isn't expensive.

points.title: 没(有) + verb: didn't / haven't
points.summary: 没 / 没有 (méi / méiyǒu) negates something that happened (or hasn't happened yet). The verb takes no 了.
points.body:
- 昨天我**没**去 (I didn't go yesterday).
- 我还**没(有)**吃饭 (I haven't eaten yet).
- After 没, drop 了: ~~我没去了~~ → 我没去.

Tip: Was it an event in the past? → 没. A habit or a decision? → 不.
examples: I didn't go to the supermarket yesterday.

points.title: 没有: don't have / there isn't
points.summary: 有 (have / there is) is always negated with 没: 没有. 不有 doesn't exist.
points.body:
- 我**没有**车 (I don't have a car).
- 房间里**没有**人 (There's nobody in the room).

points.title: 不要 + verb: don't …!
points.summary: 不要 (búyào) + verb = a negative command or request ('don't …').
points.body:
- **不要**说话! (Don't talk!)
- 你**不要**担心 (Don't worry).

别 (bié) means the same and is a bit more colloquial.

questions.explanation: A future plan is negated with **不**.
notes: 没 is for the past — 明天 is a plan.
别 is a command ('don't') — not a statement about yourself.
没有 is for the past or for 有.
questions.translation: I'm not going to school tomorrow.

notes: Adjectives are negated with 不, not 没.
没有 + adjective would mean 'hasn't become …'.
questions.translation: This piece of clothing isn't expensive.

notes: 是 is never negated with 没有.
是 is never negated with 没.
questions.translation: He isn't a teacher, he's a doctor.

questions.explanation: A past event is negated with **没**.
notes: 不去 = 'won't go / don't go' — but 昨天 is the past.
questions.translation: I didn't go to the supermarket yesterday.

notes: 还不吃 = 'still not going to eat' — not 'haven't eaten yet'.
No 了 after a verb negated with 没.
A finished past event takes 没, not 不 + 了.
不是哥哥 = 'am not an older brother'.
questions.translation: I don't have an older brother, only an older sister.

notes: Place + 不在 + person doesn't work — 在 needs the person first.
